description: Land Titile Settlement Department -  Homagagma, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land registration and title settlement matters, which is the primary focus of specialized land gazettes.
